name: relay-selfhost
description: kollab relay serve --domain runs the relay, publishes the signed discovery document and serves it as the key file, prints the TXT record and the proxy routes it still needs, and a restart keeps the same publisher key (milestone 4, issue #121). Loopback domain and ports, throwaway HOME.

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-relay-selfhost"; PY="$R/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; mkdir -p "$H"; cd "$R"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$PY" kollabor_cli_main.py relay serve --domain localhost:39443 --port 39078'

setup.description: start from an empty throwaway HOME

steps.title: first run: new key, then the operator's to-do list

steps.pattern: ready: relay up, key file published
steps.description: the command reports ready only once the relay answers and the key file is published
first run creates the signing key
points at the paste-ready proxy config
no traceback or error on the first run

steps.title: the same process serves the signed key file and the relay

steps.description: the key file over HTTP verifies against the domain
steps.command: PY="$PWD/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:39078/.well-known/agent-keys.json | "$PY" -c "import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from plugins.hub.dns.discovery import normalize_target, verify_manifest; p = json.load(sys.stdin); verify_manifest(p, normalize_target('localhost:39443')); print('key file verified; roles=' + ','.join(p['discovery']['roles']) + '; key=' + p['coordinator']['public_key'])" | tee "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-relay-selfhost.key1"

steps.description: the relay health route answers on the same port
the enrollment route is live and strict on the same port

steps.title: stop, then start again: the same signing key, so joined devices keep trusting the directory

steps.pattern: signing key loaded[\s\S]*ready: relay up, key file published
steps.description: the restart loads the key it made and is ready again
the restarted process publishes the same key
steps.command: PY="$PWD/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/../.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$PY" ] || PY=python3; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:39078/.well-known/agent-keys.json | "$PY" -c "import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); from plugins.hub.dns.discovery import normalize_target, verify_manifest; p = json.load(sys.stdin); verify_manifest(p, normalize_target('localhost:39443')); print('key file verified; roles=' + ','.join(p['discovery']['roles']) + '; key=' + p['coordinator']['public_key'])" > "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-relay-selfhost.key2"; cmp -s "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-relay-selfhost.key1" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-relay-selfhost.key2" && echo 'same publisher key after restart'

teardown.command: pkill -f 'relay serve --domain localhost:39443'; python3 -c "import os, shutil; base = os.environ.get('TMPDIR', '/tmp'); shutil.rmtree(os.path.join(base, 'kollab-spec-relay-selfhost'), ignore_errors=True); [os.remove(os.path.join(base, n)) for n in ('kollab-spec-relay-selfhost.key1', 'kollab-spec-relay-selfhost.key2') if os.path.exists(os.path.join(base, n))]"
